units.source_text: 长时间的接吻以及姑娘柔嫩的下巴颏儿的触感，唤醒了我的欲望。

en.t: The long kiss and the feel of the girl's soft chin awakened my desire.

units.source_text: 虽然这是我渴望已久的梦，但现实感却是非常淡薄的。

en.t: Although this was the dream I had long yearned for, its sense of reality was extremely faint.

units.source_text: 欲望绕着别的轨道奔驰着。

en.t: My desire was racing along some other track.

units.source_text: 灰白的阴沉的天空、竹林的沙沙声、花大姐吸着杜鹃花的叶子拼命地登攀……这些东西依然毫无秩序地、零零散散地存在着。

en.t: The gray-white gloomy sky, the rustling of the bamboo grove, Sister Hana desperately climbing while sucking on azalea leaves ... these things still existed without order, scattered in fragments.
